status.en: 8 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 47% fewer than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Golan Heights.
status.nb: 8 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 47 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Golanhøydene.

summary.en: Explosive attacks continue around Damascus, with a car bomb in a suburb killing a father and his daughter and another car bomb near the capital killing two people including a child. An improvised explosive device in Jaramana killed two civilians, one of them a young girl, and injured others. A separate car explosion in the Damascus countryside wounded two people. The violence reflects ongoing sectarian and insurgent tensions in the capital region. The conflict caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Eksplosive angrep fortsetter rundt Damaskus, med en bilbombe i en forstad som drepte en far og hans datter, og en annen bilbombe nær hovedstaden som drepte to personer, inkludert et barn. En improvisert eksplosiv enhet i Jaramana drepte to sivile, en av dem en ung jente, og såret andre. En separat bileksplosjon på landsbygda utenfor Damaskus såret to personer. Volden gjenspeiler pågående sekteriske og opprørsrelaterte spenninger i hovedstadsregionen. Konflikten forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
